name: labs/qpit__thorlabs_apt
title: Thorlabs APT motor (thorlabs_apt.Motor)
intro: Thorlabs APT motor (thorlabs_apt.Motor), adapted from qpit/thorlabs_apt. It reads `position`, `serial_number`, `in_motion`, `homing_completed` and 9 more; sets `velocity_maximum`, `acceleration`, `reverse_limit_switch`, `forward_limit_switch` and 2 more; runs `move_to`, `move_by`, `move_home`, `move_velocity` and 3 more. `move_to`: move to an absolute position in the native stage units (mm or degrees). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/qpit__thorlabs_apt --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/qpit__thorlabs_apt --backend fake --mcp
